svg.title: Poster study: neighbours prepare for the hurricane
svg.desc: Graphic poster illustration: a hurricane's spiral fills a teal sky over a coastal street; one neighbour on a ladder holds a sheet of plywood over a window, another carries a box to a car loaded with luggage, and a child in a yellow raincoat holding a dog on a leash looks up at the storm as palms bend and rain streaks across. Fictional scenario for a style study.
